plugins.description: Live-fetching loader for the Sonic Phenomenology framework. Audio enters the Binary Engine, artist+title enters the Web Engine, the two meet at the Activation Layer, the Cultural Engine scores convention violation, and the Interpretive Engine runs seven bridge types looking for somatic-structural tension. The user's felt response is final ground truth.
